trust_decision.summary: CANDIDATE MISMATCH. Advisory: user-supplied DATE_FORMAT report parameter must reach the Asset Management report SQL only as a bound value, not spliced into the query text; decided in the shipped .jrxml queries. At the pinned commit those queries already bind DATE_FORMAT/DS_DATE_FORMAT with $P{} (no $P!{}), i.e. the advisory's fix is already in the tree. The listed fix commits contain no SQL change: c0406373 is a JSON-collector XPath rewriting feature (NMS-15222), 87695af1 is an empty merge, f9f84926 is the 36.0.4 release pom/version bump.
